author: GameTrailers
description: Get an in-depth view of the future of ESO with the 2026 Seasons Direct, followed by two developer and community member roundtables. Join the team at ZeniMax Online Studios as they share the many ways ESO is evolving with new adventures, stories, challenges, and systems, plus get your first look at each Season arriving in 2026. A new age for The Elder Scrolls Online is about to begin!

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Hello Kitty Island Adventure to see what's coming to the City Town expansion for the cozy life sim game. The City Town DLC for Hello Kitty Island Adventure will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 PS5), and PC via Steam on April 16, 2026.

City Town is a rainbow metropolis teaming with mystery. Players set up all new shops with Sanrio friends like Kuromi, My Sweet Piano, and Tuxedosam, while new friend U*SA*HA*NA unlocks the customizable Imagination Cafe. Enliven the city alongside your friends and let your imagination run wild.

description:

author: GameTrailers
description:
Animalkind is out now in Early Access on PC via Steam. Watch the Animalkind launch trailer for this cozy open-world co-op adventure and town-building game. 

In Animalkind, you’ll step into the paws of adorable animal heroes piloting ancient mechs across a vibrant, post-paw-calyptic wilderness. Whether playing solo or with up to three friends in online co-op, players will gather resources, explore dynamic biomes, recruit charming townsfolk, and build a thriving community from the ground up. Blending relaxing town-building with playful multiplayer chaos, Animalkind offers a world where corgis, cats, and raccoons wield industrial-grade opposable thumbs to shape their future, one mech-powered adventure at a time.
title: Animalkind - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Melon Sandbox trailer to see what's coming with the map Update 35.0, which brings the Lava and Volcano maps to the ragdoll physics mobile game. In addition to acid pits and underwater caves, players can now explore, create, and cause chaos in two new lava-themed maps. The update also introduces lava tiles, and players can use them–alongside other environmental tiles such as water and acid–to create custom maps. Melon Sandbox is available now on iOS, Android, and the browser, and the new update is out now.

With the latest update, try to overcome flimsy physics and reach the top of the new volcano map, but challenges await, including lava bombs and scorching smoke, along with high heat and density slowly impacting your items. On the lava pool map, certain items won’t survive the high temperatures, so being strategic with your materials is key.
title: Melon Sandbox - Official 'Lava and Volcano Maps' Update Trailer

description:

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Early Access launch trailer for Cinderia, the upcoming rogue-lite action game. Cinderia is available now in Early Access on Steam.
Born from the embers of a world set ablaze, Cinderia invites you into a haunting narrative where the ancient order has fallen and kingdoms have crumbled into charred wastelands. On the night the witch ignited the world, only drifting ash remained to whisper among the ruins. Across this desolation, you play as one of the few who can still resist the spreading corruption - souls capable of swallowing the remnants of black magic without surrendering their will. With this perilous power stirring within, you will grow amidst the wreckage and draw ever closer to the truth buried beneath the world’s end.
title: Cinderia - Official Launch Trailer
